events.verdict: Smith Jr. (HOU) jumps alongside Randle (MIN) and marginal body contact occurs during Randle's (MIN) upward shooting motion.
Gobert (MIN) brushes Thompson's (HOU) arm and marginal contact occurs during Thompson's (HOU) shot attempt near the rim.
Sheppard (HOU) makes contact with the ball and brushes Randle's (MIN) forearm, making marginal contact while defending the transition shot attempt.
Sengun (HOU) rolls to the basket following the pick and he and McDaniels (MIN) make mutual marginal contact with one another.
Sengun (HOU) rolls to the basket when his elbow connects with Gobert's (MIN) head.
Tate (HOU) initiates contact with McDaniels' (MIN) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Randle (MIN) briefly engages with Smith (HOU) as they navigate the pick.
McDaniels (MIN) grabs and restricts Durant's (HOU) arm, while defending the drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Smith Jr. (HOU) defends the drive and makes marginal contact with Randle (MIN) as he loses possession of the ball on the spin move.
DiVincenzo (MIN) initiates contact with Durant (HOU) off-ball and affects his FOM on the perimeter.

Replay review of the foul called on DiVincenzo (MIN) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. DiVincenzo (MIN) initiates contact with Durant (HOU) that affects his ability to get to the pass.
Durant (HOU) and McDaniels (MIN) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and marginal contact occurs during the rebound.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Smith Jr. (HOU) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Randle (MIN) immediately slides his hand off of Durant's (HOU) side and marginal contact occurs off-ball during the inbound.
McDaniels (MIN) commits a take foul on Smith (HOU).
